prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE ORIGINAL TECHNOMANCER HOOD-AND-COLLAR OVERLAY for a 64x64 cyberpunk roguelike.
Reference role: the existing TEAL TECHNICAL COAT and broad COPPER ROBOTIC GAUNTLETS are MATERIAL / STYLE guidance only. Do not draw that whole body.
Primary request: a visibly SOFT DEEP ASYMMETRICAL HOOD with a draped upper collar, clearly a machine technician's COWL made from heavy work-cloth, with a slim lower-face respirator inset. This must have a distinctive cloth silhouette even at tiny game scale.
Draw ONLY the hood with its attached short shoulder/upper-chest collar, EMPTY front opening for an existing cyborg head. Flat straight-front worn view. No person, flesh, eyes, human face, hair, skull, mannequin, arms, hands, torso, legs, ground, pedestal or text.
GEOMETRY: a tall narrow bent hood apex, offset slightly to the viewer's right. A deep dark-edged face opening, long tapered fabric cheeks. A single large diagonal folded teal collar falls LOWER on the viewer's left of the upper chest, while the other side ends near the shoulder. The upper shoulders slope gently DOWN; no shoulder armor blocks. Fabric forms the continuous outline, with one big fold per side. The cowl has a narrow tall head silhouette and an asymmetrical sloped mantle beneath it. Its side folds merge into the collar, no disconnected pieces.
Only ONE slim charcoal lower-face breather block with a copper rim, sitting across the bottom of the face opening; it is not a visor or faceplate. ABOVE the breather, the whole face opening must be ALPHA-ZERO TRANSPARENT, no back hood lining, darkness, face, optic or glass painted across the opening. The old cybernetic face and orange eye will show through this opening after compositing.
MATERIAL: matte deep teal work-cloth, charcoal face edge/breather, a small aged copper connector on one temple. Few broad irregular cloth masses, 2-3 value shades, short broad highlights at upper-left. Cloth must LOOK SOFT with one or two clear folds. No decorative trim, fantasy symbols, filigree, crown, hard helmet dome, rigid plate crown, browband, ear cups, horizontal visor, white/silver plates or round combat helmet.
At native scale the WHOLE hood-plus-collar module will be about 26 pixels wide and 24 pixels tall, with the head opening in its upper half. Simplify aggressively: no rivets, tubes, wires, tiny vents, stitches, texture, spikes or antenna. No glow or halo.
Isolated complete module centered with comfortable transparent margins. True transparent background outside and through the upper face opening. No cast shadow.
